question: How does Arlo Smart Alarm Detection work and what alarms are compatible for Arlo Ultra Series 4K UHD Wire-Free Security Camera System (Arlo Ultra Camera and SmartHub)?

Your camera records until activity stops or for the length of time you specify (up to a maximum of 300 seconds). Compatible alarms We recommend that you test the compatibility of your alarm with the Alarm Detection feature. The Alarm Detection feature recognizes these alarms: • Smoke detectors with industry-standard T3 alarms (three intermittent beeps, followed by a period of silence). • Carbon monoxide (CO) detectors with industry-standard T4 alarms (four intermittent beeps, followed by a period of silence). The Alarm Detection feature doesn't detect alarms with other patterns. Newer smoke detectors tend to emit a T3 alarm (three intermittent beeps followed by a period of silence), and carbon monoxide detectors emit a T4 alarm (four intermittent beeps followed by a period of silence). 44Modes, Rules, and Alerts Ultra Series 4K UHD Wire-Free Security Camera System User Manual Some examples of detector models that emit compatible T3 and T4 signals include: • Kidde i9050 • USI5304 • First Alert 0827 • First Alert P1210 • First Alert SCO5 To determine your detector's alarm pattern, see the instructions that came with your detector or search online for product information.
rag_answer:
Arlo Smart Alarm Detection is a feature that notifies users in the Arlo app when a smoke or carbon monoxide (CO) detector's alarm is activated. It requires an Arlo Smart subscription to use, as stated on page 43 of the user manual. The camera might not detect an alarm in certain situations, such as if the alarm doesn't emit a T3 or T4 alarm pattern, multiple overlapping alarms occur, echoes occur in the alarm location, or another noise is equal to, or louder than, the alarm.

To test the Arlo Smart Alarm Detection range, users should place their Arlo Pro 3 Camera in the desired location, make sure that it's in Armed mode or another mode that can detect sound and motion, select Smoke/CO Alarm in the Audio Alerts setting for the camera, and turn off Other Audio. They should then use the test button on their smoke or CO detector to activate the alarm for 30 seconds and aim the camera toward the area of highest interest.

Compatible alarms for Arlo Ultra Series 4K UHD Wire-Free Security Camera System include smoke detectors that emit three intermittent beeps, followed by a period of silence (T3 alarms) and carbon monoxide (CO) detectors that emit four intermittent beeps, followed by a period of silence (T4 alarms). The test results will determine whether Arlo Smart Alarm Detection is working properly. If the user receives an Audio Alert push notification from the Arlo app on their mobile device and a video clip labeled Smoke/CO alarm? is saved in their Arlo Library, it indicates that Arlo Smart Alarm Detection is working correctly.
